name: Hidvégardó (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue and yellow triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hidvégardó: a crowned blue shield with a yellow bunch of grapes and a ploughshare, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed HIDVÉGARDÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
